{{Quote|Somewhere in this wasteland is power enough to destroy a world, remake a galaxy. My team is going to find the Czerka base, and these "artifacts" along with it. We will learn their secrets.|Darth Silthar briefs Imperial heroes recruited to assist the expedition|<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" />}}
The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] conducted an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] '''expedition''' on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[3643 BBY]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Silthar]], the expedition's mission was to discover an abandoned [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|research base]] and recover local powerful artifacts. The Imperial expedition team and the various local inhabitant groups they encountered incurred extensive casualties during the search for the base.

==The expedition==
===Stealing from the Sons===
{{GameDSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|Much of the Imperial traffic we get is assigned to the archaeological expedition. Security, scientific equipment--they don't tell me what it's for.|Imperial Military Ensign Sarinte briefs Imperial heroes newly arrived on Tatooine|<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" />}}
[[File:Darth_Silthar.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Silthar, leader of the Imperial expedition to uncover Czerka artifacts on Tatooine.]]
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY" /> the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] discovered a damaged [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] drifting through deep space that originated from a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|research base]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Czerka claimed mysterious Tatooinian artifacts in their possession were "the find of the millennium" with energy throughputs of a [[Star/Legends|sun]]. The base disappeared a month after the shuttle launch and Czerka never returned. Subsequently, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Silthar]] and [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah]] led an expedition to Tatooine to discover the base and the mysterious artifacts contained within.<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" />

The [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]] occupied the Tatooinian [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Mos Ila]], wresting control of the city from the [[Exchange]] criminal syndicate, and established a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] there to use the city as the expedition's base of operations. When four Imperial heroes<ref name="Heroes">Throughout this article, the term "Imperial heroes" is used to signify the four playable classes of the Imperial faction in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. This includes the Sith Warrior, Sith Inquisitor, Imperial Agent, and Bounty Hunter.</ref> arrived on the planet, they were directed to the service's [[Mos Ila Reclamation Service Base|research center]] in Mos Ila and joined the archaeological expedition. The expedition learned that a [[Sons of Palawa]] settlement near the city possessed experimental [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] believed to be of Czerka origin which could be examined to help discover the location of the lost Czerka base. The Imperial heroes were dispatched to the settlement to obtain the droids' [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrains]] for analysis.<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" /> While in the Sons' scrapyard, they defeated around sixteen of the tribal members and their droids that opposed them.<ref name="Crush the Palawa">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Crush the Palawa|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Though the Empire drove the Exchange out of Mos Ila upon its arrival, the gang persisted in its criminal activities in the city. While embarking on this mission for the Reclamation Service, the heroes attempted to discern the Exchange's plans. They began by obtaining communications codes on the bodies of Exchange infiltrators.<ref name="DitS1">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 1 - Danger in the Streets|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>  This allowed them to access encrypted communicator pads around the city,<ref name="DitS2">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 2 - Danger in the Streets|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> leading them to a communications station from which they lured out the local Exchange leader whom they defeated and obtained the Exchange's attack plans for retaking the city, which they delivered to Imperial authorities.<ref name="DitSF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Final Stage - Danger in the Streets|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Upon returning to the service research center, the verbobrains were analyzed by Reclamation Service [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Keighlah]] who found they'd undergone [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] but discovered the Sons purchased the droids from [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. Darth Silthar relayed to the heroes that he'd seen a band of Jawas near the city in his [[Dream/Legends|dreams]] and they departed to show the verbobrains to the Jawas and inquire about their origin.<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" />

===Dealing with Jawas===
{{Quote|Czerka's discovery is out there somewhere... sending ripples through the Force.|Darth Silthar to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" />}}
[[File:Thint.png|thumb|left|250px|Imperial heroes assisting the Empire's expedition questioned the Jawa Trade Master Thint (pictured) about the origins of Czerka droids.]]
Upon arriving at the Jawa trading compound of [[Camp Can'ali]], the heroes learned from Jawa Trade Master [[Thint]] that the Jawas salvaged the droids from an old transport module wreck in the desert which had since become lost to [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]]. The Jawas gave the heroes a lockbox obtained at the wreckage alongside the droids which they were unable to open or discern the use of.<ref name="Masters of the Desert Machines" />

Delivering the lockbox to the Reclamation Service center in Mos Ila, Cpt. Golah identified it as a Czerka stasis crate used to transport samples. A preliminary analysis revealed the crate contained a roughly spherical alien device over 10,000 [[Standard year|years]] old and contained in an [[Force field/Legends|energy field]]. While Darth Silthar departed on a pilgrimage following up on his [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] regarding the native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], the expedition deployed to their [[Reclamation Service Outpost 701|forward research outpost]] and studied the crate's device further.<ref name="Masters of the Desert Machines" />

===Confronting Sand People===
{{Quote|The Force called me into the desert. I sensed what Czerka found... an alien power. I saw a white room.|A dying Darth Silthar conveys a recent discovery to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Journey into Dust">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Journey into Dust|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}
[[File:Joroshe_Spirit_Cave.png|thumb|right|250px|Expedition leader Darth Silthar met his demise in the Sand People-inhabited Joroshe Spirit Cave (pictured) where he uncovered murals depicting the general location of the Czerka base.]]
When the Imperial heroes arrived at [[Outpost Varath]], Cpt. Golah updated them on Darth Silthar's status, saying the expedition lost his [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]'s tracking signal after Silthar summoned a lightning storm in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. Golah directed the heroes to obtain a compass in the possession of the Sand People's [[Joroshe Spirit Guides|spirit guides]] to locate Silthar.<ref name="Journey into Dust" />

Since the Sand People were becoming a major obstacle to Imperial operations in the region, while searching for Darth Silthar, the heroes struck a blow to the their tribes in the [[Shattered Basin]] by defeating at least sixty members of their forces,<ref name="BotS1" /><ref name="BotS2" /> [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] several of their [[Water/Legends|water]] supplies,<ref name="BotS3">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 3 - Blood on the Sand|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and slaying their hero, [[Kortawa]] the Hunt Master, recovering his prized hunting trophy from his body and delivering it as proof of his death to Imperial authorities.<ref name="BotSF" />

The heroes obtained a compass from one of the Sand People guides and used it to locate a wounded and dying Darth Silthar in the nearby [[Joroshe's Spirit Cave|Joroshe Spirit Cave]]. Silthar relayed to the heroes that the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] called him to the desert where he sensed Czerka's discovery and had a vision of a white room. He murdered Sand People tribals, stealing their thoughts to locate the [[Cave/Legends|cave]] where he discovered Sand People [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] depicting the location of the Czerka base in the natives' forbidden lands. The heroes recorded the paintings before departing the cave where they left Silthar's deceased body and reported to Cpt. Golah at the Reclamation Service forward outpost.<ref name="Journey into Dust" />

As the heroes reported the details of Silthar's death and the discovery of the paintings, several Reclamation Service [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] became transformed when the dampeners on the lockbox obtained from the Jawas were disabled. A transformed Lt. Keighlah made references to a figure called "[[the Imprisoned One]]" in a white room before attacking the expedition.<ref name="Journey into Dust" />

===Containing the outbreak===
{{Quote|I knew the Empire used dishonorable tactics, but the ghost of the desert--do you know what it does to people?|Sons of Palawa settlement leader to Imperial heroes arrived to contain the outbreak|<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert" />}}
[[File:Keighlah_Transformed.png|thumb|left|250px|While analyzing the Czerka device obtained from the Jawas, several expedition members were transformed into minions of the Imprisoned One.]]
The heroes defeated several of the transformed archaeologists but one, [[Perrin (Imperial Reclamation Service)|Perrin]], escaped the outpost and headed for a nearby Sons of Palawa settlement. Anticipating a potential outbreak, Cpt. Golah directed the heroes to the village to defeat Perrin before he could infect the villagers. In accordance with Reclamation Service contamination site protocols, the heroes departed for the village, located in a nearby cave, with [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] explosives to contain the potential outbreak.<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert" />

In the tribal settlement cave, the heroes found the village infested with infected Palawa warriors. The heroes defeated numerous infected and non-infected tribal warriors as well as Perrin<ref name="Burn It Out">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Burn It Out|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> while placing the explosives at key points in the cave. Departing the cave, the heroes detonated the explosives which successfully contained the infestation.<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert" />

Afterward, Cpt. Golah deployed a squad to assess the condition of the village. Squad member [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Tannrel]] reported that the explosives atomized all matter in the village and that the squad avoided engaging a small band of Palawa scouts returning to the village. Tannrel assessed that the Palawa might seek revenge on the Empire at a later date, and notified local Imperial authorities accordingly.<ref name="Sons of Palawa Report" />
{{Endgame}}

===Discovering Czerka's base===
{{Quote|Those artifacts Czerka found... they must be capable of infecting people. Transforming them. I don't know why you'd build a device like that. But some species did, long before humans lived on Tatooine. And the Reclamation Service has the job of bringing those artifacts home.|Captain Golah to Imperial heroes|<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert" />}}
[[File:Czerka_dig_site.png|thumb|right|250px|The expedition team located the abandoned Czerka archaeological dig site (pictured) in the Dune Sea.]]
At the Reclamation Service outpost, the surviving expedition members brought the Czerka lockbox's stasis field back online to prevent the artifact from powering up again and inciting another incident. The heroes returned and presented the recording of the mural from the Sand People cave which revealed the general location of Czerka's base. Cpt. Golah outfitted a probe droid to scan for signs of the base and dispatched the heroes to the Dune Sea to discover evidence of Czerka's presence.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />

Deploying the droid in the Dune Sea, it locked onto an underground power signature presumably at the Czerka base. The heroes ran additional scans at five Czerka relay towers, unlocking recorded messages revealing the fate of the Czerka base until finally pinpointing its location.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My fate--the fate of the Infinite Empire--is now within your control. You might destroy my prison, and end my eons-long existence. But bring me to your masters, instead--I shall aid them in my surrender. I will reward you with technology your kind has never seen.|The Imprisoned One makes an offer to Imperial heroes after his minions are defeated|<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />}}
[[File:The_Imprisoned_One.png|thumb|left|250px|The Reclamation Service expedition on Tatooine culminated in the discovery of a Rakata mind prison housing The Imprisoned One (pictured).]]
The Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition appeared as the Tatooine planetary story arc for all four Imperial player character classes in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]].<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" /> The arc culminated in the discovery of a [[Rakatan]] [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison|mind prison]] housing the intelligence of the [[The Imprisoned One|Imprisoned One]], an ancient Rakatan.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" /> This outcome conflicted with the conclusion of the Republic planetary story arc for Tatooine, which centered on a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] investigation into Czerka activities on the planet<ref name="Timely Arrival">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Timely Arrival|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and similarly concluded in the discovery of the Imprisoned One in the abandoned Czerka base.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found Pub">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

===Alternate stories===
After player characters retrieve the Czerka droid verbobrains in the Sons of Palawa settlement outside Mos Ila, they have the light side option to depart peacefully without attacking the remaining Sons.<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" />

When meeting with the Jawas outside Mos Ila to determine the origin of the Czerka droids, players have the light side option to accept Trade Master Thint's offer of a trade of information in exchange for clearing a path for the Jawas' [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]].<ref name="WWtW">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Who Watches the Watchers?|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref><ref name="Masters of the Desert Machines" />

As Darth Silthar lies dying in the Sand People's cave, players have the light side option to console him while he passes away, rather than to murder him.<ref name="Journey into Dust" />

When Imperial player characters arrive in the main Sons of Palawa settlement to contain the outbreak caused by the Czerka artifact, they may accept the light side option of allying and working with the uninfected Sons to purge the settlement rather than kill them.<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert" />

After discovering the Imprisoned One and defeating his minions at the conclusion of the story arc, players may select the dark side option of bringing the Imprisoned One's mind prison to Empire intact to learn from him or the light side option of destroying the mind prison to contain the threat he poses.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" /> If the dark side option is chosen, players receive an in-game message from Cpt. Golah after concluding the story arc where Golah lauds the contribution of the player character to the expedition's mission and details progress made by the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] in examining the Imprisoned One's mind prison.<ref name="Tatooine Expedition / Czerka Box">{{TORcite|type=message|Tatooine Expedition / Czerka Box|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah|Golah]]}}</ref> If the light side option was chosen, Golah sends a different message explaining the expedition team's wrap-up of an examination and lockdown of the Czerka base and the dissolution of the team to assignments on the planets [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="Tatooine Expedition Aftermath">{{TORcite|type=message|Tatooine Expedition Aftermath|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah|Golah]]}}</ref>
